how_to_raise: Edit this file in the SAME pull request that grows the number, set limit to the new ceiling, update measured and measured_on, and justify the growth in the PR body (what was added, why it cannot be smaller, what it cost). A budget is raised by a reviewed decision, never to make a red run green.

binary_bytes.what: Size in bytes of the stripped ARM plxnative binary staged by the OTT native producer: RELEASE=1, FLAVOR=stable, ARM_PROFILE=release, --no-default-features, opt-level=s, fat LTO and one codegen unit. The baseline uses the pinned Darwin-hosted SDK; Linux CI independently rebuilds and grades its staged binary against the same ceiling.

packages_default.what: Third-party (registry/git) packages the app crate compiles for armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabi with its DEFAULT features: normal + build dependencies, dev-dependencies excluded, workspace members excluded.

packages_no_default_features.what: The same count with --no-default-features, which is what every shipped binary is built with.

duplicate_versions_default.what: Crate names present in more than one version in the NORMAL-edge graph for the default feature set (the set `cargo tree -d --edges normal --target armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabi` prints).

source_lines.what: Lines of Rust under rust-modules/src, rust-modules/base/src, rust-modules/machine/src, rust-modules/net/src, rust-modules/platform/src, rust-modules/gfx/src, rust-modules/ui/src, rust-modules/plex/src, rust-modules/telemetry/src, rust-modules/data/src, rust-modules/session/src, rust-modules/media/src, rust-modules/appkit/src and rust-modules/screens/src (every .rs file). Informational: exceeding it warns and never fails, because a growing feature is not a build-health defect by itself.
